answer_1.quote: We aim to generate a response Y containing the recommendation set I and explanation U ... Path-aware Response Generation ... we employ GRU to integrate context and path information to generate a response.
answer_1.outputs: Generated conversational responses with recommended items and explanatory statements

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU-1/2 and Distinct-1/2 to evaluate the quality and diversity of the generated responses. F1 is the F1-score measuring how well the responses contain golden knowledge. In recommendation evaluation, we use Recall@K (K=1,10,25)... Hit and explainability metrics are also reported.

answer_4.quote: Six well-educated annotators evaluate each response with four scores: fluency, coherence, informativeness, and explainability. The scores are set to {0, 1, 2}. The model name is masked during the evaluation for a fair comparison.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated response on four criteria (fluency, coherence, informativeness, explainability) using a 0-2 scale.
